scenarios.when: the user explicitly asks to initialize or verify the current connection
scenarios.then: invoke init once for public identity followed by one authenticated catalog read, sharing one 20-second total deadline without retries; separate credential verification from identity and show only the relevant sanitized result

scenarios.when: A command for the bound host returns an active_connection_*, workbuddy_*, or host_credential_adapter_unavailable local failure, including when the user asks to continue generation.
scenarios.then: Stop the automatic API flow. Do not invoke connection, init, doctor, models, another Skill, or another --host as a recovery probe. Preserve the original request and any existing task ID; never resubmit automatically. Explain only that this invocation sent no API request. An explicit recheck request or verified new diagnostic evidence permits one relevant check on the same host; changing host requires explicit user selection.

scenarios.when: init cannot resolve a verified credential, cannot reach the fixed API, receives an API rejection, or receives an unconfirmed identity
scenarios.then: state that configuration verification is incomplete, show the executor's sanitized status, message, next action, and only a returned non-zero HTTP status, then still show the usage guide; do not modify configuration, claim media availability, or expose host configuration

scenarios.when: the user explicitly requests an installation or connection operation that requires a host, and the active host cannot be identified as one of the registered supported hosts
scenarios.then: Ask which supported host the user is using; do not guess the host or its configuration/Skill directory.

scenarios.when: no local terminal, PowerShell, exec, or shell execution is available
scenarios.then: state that local synchronization cannot run in this session and direct the user to give the official repository installation prompt to a terminal-capable local Agent; do not invent a manual copy command or claim success

scenarios.when: an official Skill install or update is requested
scenarios.then: Use the official native fetch wrapper, installed or freshly downloaded from the stable release to a local file. Pin the stable manifest version and source commit, verify its selector and current-platform archive, then invoke native sync. No main/source archive fallback, third-party mirror, remote shell pipe or user runtime installation.

scenarios.when: the stable manifest, selector or platform archive cannot be downloaded or the native installer cannot execute
scenarios.then: Report the actual failure and stop before installed-file writes. Do not install Git, Node, Python, Go, dependencies or an alternate transport.

scenarios.when: the host denies command execution, network approval or the initial README/fetch download before the installer starts
scenarios.then: Report installation not started, the confirmed phase and sanitized restriction. Use only host-reported permission information and available native approval controls; do not invent a grant or retry a denial. Unknown permissions stay unknown. Explain required command, HTTPS and directory access without reading configuration, changing permissions or requiring Full Access by default.

scenarios.when: a request made during a valid network grant still returns network_access_denied or tls_security_context_unavailable
scenarios.then: Preserve the valid grant as evidence but do not equate it with all execution permissions. Report the stage, safe category and review_host_permissions next step; guide the user to check current-session permissions. Do not claim a Key rejection, certificate defect, damaged sandbox or mandatory Full Access, and do not repeat the same request without a resolved blocker and explicit continuation.

scenarios.when: the user has addressed an execution/download permission blocker and explicitly asks to continue, with confirmation that sync has not begun
scenarios.then: On the same host, download the official fetch to a local file if it was never obtained, then invoke the same official workflow once. Historical approvals are evidence, not permission beyond their scope; obtain any native approval required for the current turn/action without looping on a denial. Resolve and verify the stable manifest and selected files afresh, without partial-download reuse or alternate transport. A new failure stops again; this never authorizes paid-task resubmission.

scenarios.when: sync is confirmed successful, only init failed, and the user explicitly asks to continue connection verification after addressing the blocker
scenarios.then: Invoke only the installed executor init once on the same host, with its existing 20-second budget and at most two read-only requests. Do not fetch, sync, reinstall, run doctor or submit a paid task. Keep installation status separate from the new verification result.

scenarios.when: the stable selector or platform archive fails checksum or source validation
scenarios.then: report the validation failure and stop before changing installed Skills. Do not run Node, npm packages, generators, docs sync, formatters, repair commands, Git writes, or any other source-mutating command to make the official checkout pass.

scenarios.when: the host interrupts, times out, or otherwise returns before the installer prints the exact synchronized-version completion receipt
scenarios.then: Report synchronization as unconfirmed without automatic retry. Obtain separate authorization for local installation diagnosis before deciding on recovery; doctor is not an inventory verifier. Preserve unknown or modified files and unresolved transactions. Only a separately authorized official sync can recover a verified managed transaction; this is not a permission-retry case.

scenarios.when: a current target directory is missing the matching managed Skill markers
scenarios.then: report the exact conflict and stop before changing any target directory; do not overwrite, delete, rename, or merge it

scenarios.when: a supported host has no conflicting target directories
scenarios.then: Run the official sync once, report the synchronized version and relevant changes, then advise a new host conversation. Do not repeat the full seven-Skill version list.

scenarios.when: the user asks what Pure Tokens is, what it is for, how to get started, how the website / Switch / Skills differ, or how to use Skills
scenarios.then: Read the installed usage guide and answer only the requested scope. No host clarification, configured connection prerequisite, executor, init, doctor, credential access, network read, installation, update or paid example. Current models, groups, prices and account permissions are not static promises.

scenarios.when: the user asks whether an update exists
scenarios.then: Run fetch check-update for the current host. It reads the stable manifest and verified selector to compare the installed version without synchronization or init. A matching version alone does not prove installed integrity.

scenarios.when: the user explicitly requests installation or connection diagnostics
scenarios.then: Invoke the installed native doctor once with the current host. Report known-directory version/duplicate findings and separate public identity, credential checks, checksum status and unverified host attachment delivery. Do not scan unrelated paths or auto-fix.

scenarios.when: a same-name directory lacks verified ownership or has added, modified, missing or symlinked entries
scenarios.then: stop replacement and preserve the directory; do not delete files, regenerate ownership markers, or claim synchronization; interrupted recovery retains the backup on the same conflict

scenarios.when: a sibling installer carries the old locate marker but does not support the requested host
scenarios.then: download and checksum-verify the directory selector from the same stable release; never reuse the sibling based only on its marker

scenarios.when: install or update finds the selected stable version already installed
scenarios.then: Verify the selected release executor checksum and all nine managed inventories. Only an intact installation with no unresolved transaction returns already current, without archive download, file writes or init. Missing or modified files stop without automatic repair.

scenarios.when: official installation cannot launch the executor, capture output or finish within its timeout
scenarios.then: Stop and report completed stages and the sanitized failure. Do not create probes, shims, Python patches, modify official scripts, switch launch mechanisms, run doctor repeatedly or resubmit installation automatically. Required host approvals remain required.
